title: Cancel manual bag out exchange tasks that are not in process
summary: When performing a manual bag out, use the “cancel bag out” option to cancel exchange tasks that are not currently in process. Exchange tasks already in an exchange must be allowed to come and still finish.
when_to_use: Use during a manual bag out when you need to cancel exchange tasks/chests that are not in process, while ensuring any exchange already in progress is allowed to complete.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Initiates the manual bag out and selects the “cancel bag out” option, ensuring the cancellation scope does not include exchanges already in process.
access_or_tools_needed: Bag out control system UI/control (manual bag out and cancel bag out options)

system_preconditions: A manual bag out is being performed (the bag out control system is available for manual bag out).

visual_references.description: Bag out control system screen/frame showing manual bag out and the “cancel bag out” rule (cancel exchange tasks not in process; in-exchange must still finish).

steps.title: Initiate the manual bag out action from the bag out control system
steps.purpose: Start the manual bag out workflow so the “cancel bag out” option can be applied to the correct cancellation scope.
steps.instruction: On the bag out control system, initiate the manual bag out action (the UI/control that provides manual bag out and cancel bag out options).
steps.expected_result: The bag out control system is in the manual bag out context where the cancel bag out option is available.
steps.healthy_condition: Manual bag out is selected/active on the bag out control system UI.
steps.failure_condition: Manual bag out is not active (cancel bag out option cannot be applied correctly).

actions.label: Start manual bag out
actions.exact_action: Initiate the manual bag out action from the bag out control system

source_evidence.quote: In the event of a manual bag out Fortna offers a cancelled bag out.

steps.title: Select the “cancel bag out” option
steps.purpose: Apply the cancellation behavior intended for manual bag out so that only exchange tasks not in process are cancelled.
steps.instruction: In the manual bag out UI/control, select the “cancel bag out” option.
steps.expected_result: The system applies the cancel bag out behavior for the manual bag out operation.
steps.healthy_condition: “Cancel bag out” is selected in the bag out control system during the manual bag out workflow.
steps.failure_condition: A different bag out mode is selected (cancel bag out is not applied).

source_evidence.quote: Fortna offers a cancelled bag out that will cancel any exchange task that is not in process.

steps.title: Verify cancellation scope: cancel exchange tasks/chests that are not in process
steps.purpose: Ensure the cancellation scope matches the rule: only exchange tasks/chests that are not currently in process are cancelled.
steps.instruction: Confirm that the cancel bag out behavior is intended to cancel exchange tasks/chests that are not in process (i.e., not currently in an exchange).
steps.expected_result: Exchange tasks/chests that are not in process are cancelled by the cancel bag out behavior.
steps.healthy_condition: Cancellation affects only exchange tasks/chests that are not currently in process.
steps.failure_condition: Cancellation affects exchange tasks/chests that are already in process (violates the in-exchange completion rule).

actions.label: Check cancellation scope rule
actions.exact_action: Verify the cancellation scope matches the rule: cancel any exchange task/chest that is not in process

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the cancel bag out action cancels items that are already in process.

source_evidence.quote: This will cancel any exchange chest that is not in process.

steps.title: Ensure in-process exchanges are allowed to finish
steps.purpose: Prevent disruption of exchange tasks already in process by ensuring they are allowed to come and still finish.
steps.instruction: Before/while applying cancel bag out, ensure that any exchange task/chest that is already in an exchange is not cancelled; it must be allowed to come and still finish.
steps.expected_result: Exchange tasks/chests already in an exchange continue to completion (they are not cancelled by cancel bag out).
steps.healthy_condition: In-process exchange tasks/chests continue and complete as part of the bag out workflow.
steps.failure_condition: An exchange task/chest that is already in process is cancelled or does not complete.

actions.label: Confirm in-exchange completion behavior
actions.exact_action: Ensure you do not cancel exchange tasks that are already in process: if it is in an exchange, it has to come and still has to finish.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the cancel bag out action cancels items that are already in process.
Stop and escalate if non-in-process exchange tasks are not cancelled as described.

source_evidence.quote: You can cancel the bag out, but it has to be not in the exchange. So like if it's in an exchange, it has to come. That one still has to finish.

success_criteria: Exchange tasks/chests not in process are cancelled during the manual bag out cancel bag out behavior.
Exchange tasks/chests already in process continue and still finish.
healthy_conditions: Cancel bag out cancels only exchange tasks/chests that are not in process.
Any exchange already in process is allowed to come and still finish.
failure_conditions: Cancel bag out cancels exchange tasks/chests that are already in process.
Exchange tasks/chests that are not in process are not cancelled as described.
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate if the cancel bag out action cancels items that are already in process, or if non-in-process exchange tasks are not cancelled as described.
missing_details: The packet does not provide the exact UI label text for the manual bag out initiation control (only that a bag out control system exists).
The packet does not provide the exact UI label text for the “cancel bag out” button beyond the phrase “cancel bag out/cancelled bag out”.
The packet does not specify how to visually confirm, on the live system, which exchange tasks/chests are “in process” vs “not in process” (no UI field names/statuses are provided).
